description: Return one KovAPI documentation page as Markdown. Pass a path or URL, e.g. /docs/api, /docs/nano-banana-2, /docs/guide/errors, /docs/integrations/claude-code, /docs-guide, /docs/webhooks, or a docs.kovapi.com URL. A language prefix (/zh /en /es /ja /ko /ru) picks the language; the bare path is the site default.
name: read_doc
title: Read a docs page as Markdown
